name: Four Seasons Hotel, One Dalton Street
insider_take: Boston's newest luxury tower seamlessly blends into the prestigious Back Bay skyline while delivering Four Seasons' signature sophistication just steps from iconic Fenway Park.
whats_special: This 61-story architectural marvel is Boston's second-tallest building, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows with breathtaking views of the Charles River and city skyline. The hotel occupies floors 1-19 of this mixed-use tower, which also houses ultra-luxury residences above. Its prime location puts you within walking distance of Berklee College of Music, the Prudential Center, and the legendary Green Monster at Fenway Park.
pro_tip: Book a west-facing room above the 15th floor for unobstructed views of Fenway Park – you can actually watch Red Sox games from your window during baseball season!
dont_miss: The hotel's Zuma restaurant marks the renowned Japanese dining concept's Boston debut, while the rooftop wellness floor offers a serene spa experience high above the bustling Back Bay. Take advantage of the hotel's proximity to the Freedom Trail, which passes just blocks away, connecting you to 16 historic Revolutionary War sites throughout the city.
pros: Prime Back Bay location with easy access to Newbury Street and Fenway Park
Modern luxury tower with floor-to-ceiling windows offering stunning city views
Exceptional Four Seasons service and attention to detail
State-of-the-art fitness center and spa facilities
cons: High-rise tower setting may feel less intimate than boutique properties
